subject.title: feat(ui): publish host style variables to embedded MCP apps

question: Should OpenClaw accept this interim Control UI-to-MCP style-variable mapping now, or require the larger shared embed-token migration first?
rationale: The branch introduces a new host presentation contract and intentionally chooses an interim owner boundary; protocol conformance alone cannot decide whether that maintenance tradeoff fits the Control UI roadmap.

options.title: Accept the interim mapping
options.body: Merge after real host-and-app proof, while retaining the stated plan to remove the table once Control UI adopts the shared embed tokens.

options.title: Wait for shared tokens
options.body: Pause this PR and land the Control UI embed-token migration first so the host can publish one canonical token vocabulary.

recommendation.title: Accept the interim mapping
recommendation.body: Merge after real host-and-app proof, while retaining the stated plan to remove the table once Control UI adopts the shared embed tokens.
